component.name: YouTube Music Shell
component.summary: Minimal, hardened desktop player for YouTube Music

description.p: YTM Shell is a secure, resource-efficient desktop wrapper for YouTube Music built with Rust and Tauri. It features native WebKitGTK 4.1 sandboxing, multi-layered ad and telemetry blocking, MPRIS D-Bus desktop integration, global hardware media keys, and persistent login with isolated profile storage.

ul.li: Hardened WebKitGTK 4.1 engine with WebRTC disabled and context menu suppression
Layer A DOM scriptlets and Layer B native WebKit Content Rule List adblock matching
System tray controls with close-to-tray background playback and single-instance enforcement
Full Linux MPRIS D-Bus integration for GNOME, KDE, and playerctl
Sub-10 MB binary footprint and minimal RAM utilization

description.p: Initial release with hardened security architecture, MPRIS media keys, and adblocking engine.
